devices.name: Electrocoagulation wash-water recycler
devices.summary: Treats used wash water so it can go around again instead of down the drain.
devices.how: A low-voltage current passes through metal plates sitting in the water. The plates release ions that bind fine solids, oils and soaps into clumps large enough to separate. The cleared water returns to the wash loop.
measuring: Share of water recovered per cycle
devices.next: Publish a first set of in and out readings as a field note.

devices.name: High-speed torsion and compression plate device
devices.summary: A mechanical device that works water between plates under high-speed torsion and compression.
devices.how: This one is early. A prototype exists. What it does to the water has not been measured well enough to describe, so we are not describing it yet. Sensors go on first.
devices.next: Finish instrumentation, then run a baseline against plain recirculation.
